flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 100% up its 52-week range, RS 100, 0% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company expects AUM to grow by more than 40% with a focus on disciplined asset quality and secured business scale-up.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management is targeting a gross NPA below 2.25% and a 10%-15% reduction in impairment costs.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company intends to add at least 80 more branches for its LAP business by the end of the current financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: A new fully-owned subsidiary has been created to distribute mutual funds and wealth products.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Now, it so happens if you have to distribute mutual fund, it is best done via separate entity and that is why we have created this fully-owned subsidiary for selling mutual fund and other wealth products primarily." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 10.3% earnings growth vs 47% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
Management remains optimistic about the long-term structural credit opportunity in India for FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "As we look ahead to FY27, we remain optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Demand is supported by economic growth and significant credit under-penetration in India.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Many reasons for that, not only economic growth that the country will see, but also the huge degree of credit under penetration which exists, while at the same time being realistic and cautious about near-term conditions." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The Loan Against Property AUM stands at ₹518 crore across 98 branches.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "LAP AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore, across 98 branches in 8 states, contributing 7.3% of total AUM." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company has served more than 11.76 million unique customers.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "We have served over 11.76 million unique customers till date." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Thin interest cover leaves little headroom if earnings dip.
threats.evidence: Operating profit 739 Cr vs interest 341 Cr = 2.17x cover (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Global factors such as oil prices, elevated rates, and currency volatility are weighing on the Indian environment.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The global environment has been one of the defining themes of the recent past - higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, currency volatility, these are all the factors weighing on India too." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The company paused lending in approximately 450 pin codes due to elevated risk signals.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As a measure of prudence, we reduced disbursements by approximately 7% and paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes, where early-warning systems flagged elevated risks - while continuing to grow in high-quality segments." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The Loan Against Property business has not yet reached breakeven and is expected to take one to two years to reach steady-state ROA.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "LAP continues to be a business which has not reached breakeven. And we are still probably a year or two away from being at steady state ROA." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S31/W27/O29/T21), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 77 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
